messages:
sara_support: FYI AcmePay reported a regression after this morning's rollout. They say invoice summarization responses dropped line-item detail and started returning short ‘summary’ paragraphs instead of CSV-like rows. Customer only sees this from eu-west-2.

acme: (pasted to Sara privately) 'calls from us-west and ap-sg look fine' — forwarded to support.

sara_support: Repro steps I ran: cURL to /v1/generate with model=redwood-3b-v2, prompt 'Summarize invoice with line items', system:invoice->json. Response from eu-west-2 is missing items. Request-id=rid_eu_0001, session=ses-9c.

mike_eng_runtime: Can you paste the exact request body + headers (content-type, model, and any flags like int8/quant)? Also which pool/gpu is serving those requests?

sara_support: paste: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-3b-v2","prompt":"Summarize invoice with line items","response_format":"json","max_tokens":512,"quality_profile":"balanced","runtime_flags":{"quantize":"int8"}}' ``` Served from eu-west-2 pool: eu-west-2-a100-80gb-pool-3.

ana_research: (typo fix) ana_research: Noted. We rolled a kernel/quantization patch to eu-west-2 at 2026-03-16T03:14:02Z as part of v2.8.0 canary. Other regions still on older kernel. Possible int8 path difference.

ops-eu: deploy-bot: Canary v2.8.0 started 2026-03-16T03:10Z -> patch 2026-03-16T03:14Z applied to eu-west-2 pools.

mike_eng_runtime: Thanks. Can you attach a short token stream diff? Even a truncated example helps. Also include any rerun with runtime_flags.quantize disabled.

sara_support: Token stream snippet from eu-west (rid_eu_0001): ```[CLS] Invoice Summary: Total $1234
- Item A x1
- Item B x2 -> (then abruptly) \u2063\u2063 'See attached.'``` Rerun with quantize removed returns full items. Request-id rid_eu_0002.

ana_research: ana_research: This looks like an int8 kernel fallback that produces early stop tokens on A100 vector path. I want kernel logs and perf counters (kv_cache misses, fallback reasons).

ops-eu: Grabbing kernel logs now from pool eu-west-2-a100-80gb-pool-3, will paste shortly. If confirmed we can roll back patch from 03:14 to previous kernel on that pool.

mike_eng_runtime: Also check tokenizer version and bytepair vocab used in eu-west runtime. If kernel changed how stop/separator tokens are handled under quantized matmul, it could token-shift.

sara_support: Customer requests fast rollback or mitigations (they're hitting production). Customer SLA flagged.

ops-eu: Kernel logs show a 'quant_fma_fallback' at 03:14:12 for ses-9c on worker gw-12. Pasting short log: ```[03:14:12.112] quant_fma_fallback: fallback_reason=partial_block_align, affected_ops=matmul_1, session=ses-9c, request=rid_eu_0001```

ana_research: ana_research: That fallback_reason matches a known edge-case where 512-blocks unaligned on A100 int8 path led to early EOS token when using specific kv cache alignment. We have a hotfix, but need to validate.

mike_eng_runtime: Plan: 1) Roll back kernel on eu-west-2 pool to pre-03:14 state (ops-eu), 2) Ask customer to retry rid_eu_0003, 3) Run unit regression across sample suite. Ops, please schedule rollback ASAP and mark as hot_patch.

ops-eu: Rolling back kernel now to 2026-03-15 build. ETA 5m. Will notify when done.

sara_support: Telling AcmePay we will rollback and ask them to retry in ~10m. :pray:

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for eu-west-2-a100-80gb-pool-3 by ops-eu at 2026-03-16T03:28:10Z.

ops-eu: Rollback complete at 2026-03-16T03:33:20Z. All nodes healthy.

mike_eng_runtime: Sara, ask customer to rerun same request and paste new req id. Also capture response hash and token stream.

sara_support: AcmePay retried. New request rid_eu_0004. Response includes full line-items again. Customer confirms behavior back to normal.

ana_research: ana_research: We'll schedule a canary re-run with the hotfix applied in a staging pool and add a targeted regression test for invoice-style prompts and int8 path on A100.

mike_eng_runtime: Filing a follow-up ticket to prevent merging the problematic kernel into global rollout until tested: INF-6632.

sara_support: Closing loop with customer, flagged for SLA credit. Will keep thread updated if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
